name: nmap
description: Network discovery and security auditing toolkit with comprehensive scanning capabilities

tools.description: Nmap's network Swiss Army knife for connectivity and data transfer
tools.usage:
ncat -l 8080 # Listen on port 8080
ncat example.com 80 # Connect to HTTP port
ncat --broker --listen 8080 # Chat server
ncat --ssl example.com 443 # SSL connection
echo 'GET / HTTP/1.0' | ncat example.com 80

tools.description: Network reconnaissance engine with NSE scripts for deep service enumeration and OS fingerprinting
tools.usage:
nmap -sS -O target.com # Stealth SYN scan with OS detection
nmap --script vuln target.com # Vulnerability enumeration
nmap -sV --script discovery target.com # Service version detection
nmap -p- --min-rate 10000 target.com # Fast full port scan

tools.description: Packet capture library installer for Windows network packet analysis
tools.usage:
npcap-1.83.exe /S # Silent installation
npcap-1.83.exe /LOOPBACK_SUPPORT=yes # Install with loopback support
npcap-1.83.exe /WINPCAP_MODE=yes # WinPcap compatibility mode

tools.description: Helper utility for managing Npcap driver installation and configuration
tools.usage:
NpcapHelper.exe --install-driver # Install Npcap driver
NpcapHelper.exe --uninstall-driver # Remove Npcap driver
NpcapHelper.exe --check-status # Check driver status

tools.description: Advanced ping utility with custom packet crafting and network troubleshooting capabilities
tools.usage:
nping --tcp -p 80 target.com # TCP ping to port 80
nping --udp -p 53 dns-server.com # UDP ping to DNS
nping --icmp target.com # Traditional ICMP ping
nping --arp 192.168.1.1 # ARP ping for local networks

tools.description: Wireless network helper utility for WiFi adapter management and configuration
tools.usage:
WlanHelper.exe --scan # Scan for available networks
WlanHelper.exe --monitor-mode # Enable monitor mode
WlanHelper.exe --list-adapters # Show wireless adapters
WlanHelper.exe --set-channel 6 # Set wireless channel
